goal.original: Build Place: a third Composite front end that stamps an image onto the current entry, with a gizmo, three slot origins and a Remove Background toggle. Absorbs MPI-377.
goal.summary: Place shipped in 3eb09d26 and was verified live on a private app instance (663 node + 24 desktop tests, seven registry guards mutation-proved RED, preview and written file agreeing to the pixel). task_card.title: Place - a composite tool that stamps an image onto the current entry

next_action.description: Launch a private instance with `npm run app:isolated` (NEVER :3000, that is the user's app), open an image group, arm Place, fill the slot, drag and scale the image, then press the resize button. It must restore the image's own pixel dimensions WITHOUT moving it and WITHOUT unrotating it, and must never come back square - the square was the bug. Then drop an image on a VIDEO group and confirm it still becomes a PromptBox chip rather than arming Place. Both pass -> move MPI-454 to done.

key_decisions: Undo (acceptance 12) is the paint-Apply contract, NOT a gizmo transform history - the user ruled 'leave it as is, I'll card it later if annoying'. Do not reopen it.
NO feather on the cut-out, ever, as a default: the user's detailing pass after Place is what blends the object, and a blanket feather would damage images that do not want one.
The group keeps the name Composite - three tools, one artifact, which is what the MPI-424 taxonomy groups by.

The re-centre button is a RESIZER now: restorePlaceSize() restores the image's own pixel dimensions IN PLACE, keeping position and rotation. A placement is a picture; moving it would undo a placement the user was happy with.
The gizmo is ShapeManager with a third destination 'place' rather than a forked manager, so the app's two gizmos cannot drift apart.
Place has NO scratch layer - it rasterises only at Apply, straight at the base entry's own size, so the plan's PAINT_MAX_EDGE 4096 ceiling never applied.
constraints: `seed()` with no argument seeds a SQUARE. That is what caused the squash bug. Any new path that re-seeds a placement must pass the image's aspect - MpiCanvas.loadImage and resetShape both do, and a test holds them there.

deferCommit is honoured ONLY in the gallery branch, selected by the ABSENCE of `existingGroup`. Pass one and the Remove Background cut-out is silently committed as a history entry, which is the pollution the user rejected in MPI-377.
A live peer session exists in this tree. MPI-454's 18 paths are claimed in .agents/mpi-kanban/state/files/1cec767c-d659-40eb-96d6-2033c391fe0c.json - release it (status: complete) at close-out.

board.json and .agents/mpi-kanban/events.jsonl are CO-OWNED: an earlier uncommitted session moved MPI-377/MPI-562 to done and created MPI-596, and in board.json those edits share hunks with the MPI-454 move. Both commits so far staged rebuilt-from-HEAD blobs (.claude/rules/git.md). Do not `git add` them wholesale.
js/data/modelConstants/models.js, tasks/MPI-377/, tasks/MPI-562/ and tasks/MPI-596/ are another session's uncommitted work. Leave them alone.
Nothing has been PUSHED. CLAUDE.md makes push a user-authorized op even though project-profile push_policy is `auto`.
